rule.rule: no install record: execute the plan's CREATE/REPLACE rows; LEAVE rows are strictly zero-write and never adopted

FRESH.rule: no install record: execute the plan's CREATE/REPLACE rows; LEAVE rows are strictly zero-write and never adopted

IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY.rule: same package_id AND same feature_set_id AND every recorded file byte-identical => REPLAY: resolve() still runs first, plan and per-file reconciliation are still produced, but ZERO bytes are written to the game dir (not even the manifest/seal are refreshed). Second install is IDEMPOTENT, not refused and not a silent re-write.
IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY.on_drift: any sha256 drift / orphan => REFUSE (never overwrite)

SUBSET_UPGRADE.rule: same package_id but a DIFFERENT feature_set_id => execute the new plan; files the old record names that the new shipped() drops leave through v13 ORPHAN-FIX01 (_plan_orphans), and those removals are listed in the reconciliation report

LEGACY_PRE_PLAN.rule: an existing install record with NO feature_set_id (v13 or older, e.g. W22 --adopt-legacy records) cannot be reconciled against a plan: --adopt-legacy is REQUIRED to assert the successor relation; with it the record is adopted, the plan is executed and the new record is stamped with feature_set_id

DIFFERENT_PACKAGE.rule: different package_id => v13 PKG-IDENT01 exit 3 stands; the plan never releases that identity gate
